title: verbascum thapsiforme var. bicolle
intro: Verbascum thapsiforme var. bicolle, commonly known as the common mullein or tall mullein, is a biennial plant species in the genus Verbascum. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis, as well as its use in treating skin conditions like eczema and acne due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum thapsiforme var. bicolle are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, iridoids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to soothe sore throats, calm irritated skin, and promote wound healing.
